description.en: Windows 上给 agent 一个真正的 Git Bash 命令工具:私有 Git Bash 执行器实例(官方 PowerShell 执行器原样保留),统一 MSYS 盘根路径方言,官方 pwsh 工具默认隐藏可开关,物化四个内置预设的 Git Bash 变体,侧栏终端接管可开关。· Give agents a real Git Bash tool on Windows: a private Git Bash executor instance (the official PowerShell executor stays untouched), a unified MSYS drive-root path dialect, an opt-in official pwsh tool, and four Git Bash preset variants.
description.zh: Windows 上给 agent 一个真正的 Git Bash 命令工具:私有 Git Bash 执行器实例(官方 PowerShell 执行器原样保留),统一 MSYS 盘根路径方言,官方 pwsh 工具默认隐藏可开关,物化四个内置预设的 Git Bash 变体,侧栏终端接管可开关。· Give agents a real Git Bash tool on Windows: a private Git Bash executor instance (the official PowerShell executor stays untouched), a unified MSYS drive-root path dialect, an opt-in official pwsh tool, and four Git Bash preset variants.

description.en: Free web search for DeepSeek Harness: 39 engines (Bing/DuckDuckGo/AnySearch/SearXNG/Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Firecrawl/Parallel/You.com keyless; Zhihu global/site via MCP and Perplexity/SerpBase/DeepSeek (official + native tools/search)/Baidu/Kimi/Aliyun/Doubao/Google CSE/Metaso/Yandex/Yuanbao with key; OpenAI/Gemini/Claude model built-in search, explicit-only) + auto smart routing + global engine enable/disable & fallback priority + editable zh/en language pools + multi mode (parallel full language-pool merge) + multi_search cross-source tool + failure-aware fallback (quota/auth cooldown, transient retry, fallbackOn) + time filtering + platform search + domain blocklist (blockedDomains) + web_fetch, with web settings UI, plus a standalone stdio MCP server.
description.zh: Free web search for DeepSeek Harness: 39 engines (Bing/DuckDuckGo/AnySearch/SearXNG/Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Firecrawl/Parallel/You.com keyless; Zhihu global/site via MCP and Perplexity/SerpBase/DeepSeek (official + native tools/search)/Baidu/Kimi/Aliyun/Doubao/Google CSE/Metaso/Yandex/Yuanbao with key; OpenAI/Gemini/Claude model built-in search, explicit-only) + auto smart routing + global engine enable/disable & fallback priority + editable zh/en language pools + multi mode (parallel full language-pool merge) + multi_search cross-source tool + failure-aware fallback (quota/auth cooldown, transient retry, fallbackOn) + time filtering + platform search + domain blocklist (blockedDomains) + web_fetch, with web settings UI, plus a standalone stdio MCP server.
